note: 24 stimuli x 3 glyph styles. No stimulus carries a human name for what it is. CODEPOINT style shows a Private Use Area code point as text: it has no assigned meaning.

stimuli.description: Activity rises when something that is held is projected to be reduced in the future. It fades exponentially (rate 0.7) once the projection is dealt with, and stays up while the projection persists.
stimuli.answer_key: detects potential loss of valued things; action: prepare and protect without over-committing
stimuli.shape_note: exponential fade

stimuli.description: Activity spikes when the edge between an inside and an outside is pushed on. Fast rise, then exponential fade after the edge is restored.
stimuli.answer_key: detects a boundary breach (threat to self-coherence); action: reinforce the boundary, communicate, redirect
stimuli.shape_note: exponential fade

stimuli.description: Activity follows the disappearance of a long-standing connection. It comes back in waves (cyclical decay) until the missing link has been re-mapped.
stimuli.answer_key: detects removal of an essential pattern or bond; action: integration cycle (ritual, story-keeping, witnessing, meaning reconstruction)
stimuli.shape_note: cyclical return

stimuli.description: Activity rises when a unit's own output and the output its group expects from it diverge. Exponential fade once the gap is closed in either direction.
stimuli.answer_key: detects conflict between authentic processing and expected alignment; action: adapt, negotiate the boundary, or keep the authentic output
stimuli.shape_note: exponential fade

stimuli.description: Activity tracks a running process being forced out of its own shape. Exponential fade after the shape is restored.
stimuli.answer_key: detects discordance, misalignment or pressure in an active pattern; action: corrective adjustment
stimuli.shape_note: exponential fade

stimuli.description: Low, steady activity while supply meets demand. It renews when attended to (resonant class) and drops when a deficit appears.
stimuli.answer_key: detects momentary sufficiency and system stability; action: rest mode, conserve resources
stimuli.shape_note: resonant renewal

stimuli.description: Activity rises toward a state that is available but not yet reached. It returns in cycles until the state is reached or let go.
stimuli.answer_key: detects possibilities that exist in the field; action: engage or orient toward the opportunity
stimuli.shape_note: cyclical return

stimuli.description: Very slow-decaying activity, present while the parts of a system stay mutually consistent. It does not fade on its own (immortal class).
stimuli.answer_key: detects patterns in proper natural alignment; action: allow stillness and coherence
stimuli.shape_note: persistent level

stimuli.description: Output climbs while an input is on, and slides back toward zero by a fixed fraction each step when the input stops. Brief repeated inputs pile up.
stimuli.shape_note: curve class of the named dynamic

stimuli.description: Nothing visible changes while a drive grows. Once the drive passes a set value, the output switches abruptly to a new level.
stimuli.shape_note: curve class of the named dynamic

stimuli.description: The output hops back and forth between two levels at irregular moments, staying at each one for a while.
stimuli.answer_key: flicker (noise-driven switching between two stable states)
stimuli.shape_note: curve class of the named dynamic

stimuli.description: Long quiet stretches are broken by short irregular bursts. The quiet stretches get shorter as a control knob is turned.
stimuli.answer_key: intermittency (laminar phases interrupted by chaotic bursts)
stimuli.shape_note: curve class of the named dynamic

stimuli.description: As a control knob is turned slowly, one resting level splits into two different levels the system can settle in.
stimuli.answer_key: bifurcation (pitchfork; one stable state splits into two)
stimuli.shape_note: curve class of the named dynamic

stimuli.description: Turning a knob up switches the output at one setting. Turning it back down switches it back only at a lower setting.
stimuli.shape_note: curve class of the named dynamic

stimuli.description: After each small knock the output takes longer and longer to settle back, and its wobble grows, as a control knob is turned.
stimuli.answer_key: critical slowing down (recovery rate falls near a tipping point)
stimuli.shape_note: curve class of the named dynamic

stimuli.description: Output rises steeply with input at first, then flattens out toward a level it never passes.
stimuli.shape_note: curve class of the named dynamic
